question.en: Which decisions does the camera make?

summary.en: Separate hardware from exposure choices and stabilization behavior.
summary.zh-cn: 把硬件与曝光操作、防抖行为分开。

boundary.en: P/A/S/M are operating modes. IBIS addresses camera movement, not subject movement. ISO alone does not add incoming photons.
boundary.zh-cn: P/A/S/M 是操作模式。机身防抖针对相机运动，不能冻结主体；只提高 ISO 不会增加入射光子。
